text.description: Message text, delivered to the user's private chat on the messenger they use (Telegram, MAX or VK), with a copy in the user's Open Lines topic.

buttons.description: Up to 3 rows of up to 3 buttons. url buttons work on every messenger and with every credential; callback buttons are an integration mechanism of an ExternalApp key subscribed to the button.clicked webhook when the app was provisioned, and work only for a Telegram user. The Open Lines copy carries only the url buttons.

idempotency_key.description: Repeating a key within your app returns the same notification_id and does not queue a second push while the first one is still known to the queue.

callback_data.description: An integration mechanism of an ExternalApp key: when the user taps the button, the value is delivered by the button.clicked webhook to the server of the app that sent the push, so the app must have been subscribed to the button.clicked webhook when it was provisioned, otherwise the button is refused with INVALID_BUTTON_CONFIG. Sent with any other credential (an OAuth grant or an M2M credential) a callback button is refused with INVALID_BUTTON_CONFIG; the MCP send_notification tool carries url buttons only. The platform prefixes it with ext:{app}:, and the prefixed value must fit 64 bytes. Answered only for a Telegram user: for a MAX or VK user a callback button is refused with INVALID_BUTTON_CONFIG — use a url button.

status.description: Accepted for asynchronous delivery as a transactional message; promotional messages go through broadcasts, and a personal text for each customer through a reply batch. A push is dropped if not handed over for delivery within 24 hours of being accepted; an accepted push not yet handed over is also dropped if the platform switches push delivery off in an emergency; a user who blocked the bot or was deleted receives nothing.

invitee_goal_target.description: What the bot opens for a NEW INVITEE once, on the tap that attributed them to their inviter (referral axis: first inviter only, within 7 days of the user appearing). Replaces the welcome on that tap; a chain step target starts the funnel and the AI waits for it. Allowed targets: {kind:"section_root",section:"catalog"|"booking"|"events"} or {kind:"deeplink",entity_type:"product"|"catalog_group"|"menu_group"|"event"|"resource"|"chain_step"|"marketing_campaign"|"marketing_link"|"form",entity_id:<seq_num>}. url, web_app and delivery_message are refused. The target must exist and be active. A marketing_campaign / marketing_link target delivers that campaign's message or opens its target. null clears it. Partner re-attribution never fires it.

inviter_goal_target.description: What the bot opens for the INVITER once in their life, when their first invitee is attributed to them while this goal is set (e.g. a thank-you funnel or a bonus campaign); a personal notification, sent regardless of the marketing opt-out. Allowed targets: {kind:"section_root",section:"catalog"|"booking"|"events"} or {kind:"deeplink",entity_type:"product"|"catalog_group"|"menu_group"|"event"|"resource"|"chain_step"|"marketing_campaign"|"marketing_link"|"form",entity_id:<seq_num>}. url, web_app and delivery_message are refused. The target must exist and be active. A marketing_campaign / marketing_link target delivers that campaign's message or opens its target. A chain step does not restart a funnel run the inviter is already in. null clears it.

get.summary: Read a tenant user and permitted relation projections
get.description: Resolves the tenant user by its per-tenant id, never a platform PK. The card is the same one the list and MCP get_customer publish (ADR-375): contacts, statuses, tags, counters, partner_id (partner program) and inviter_id (referral program) as tenant ids, marketing_consent, topic_url and invite_code. channel_user_id is the messenger-native id as a string, qualified by channel. ApiKeyOrJwtGuard accepts X-Api-Key, Bearer tgf_* or a verified surface JWT. ScopeGuard still requires pull:users: a scope-free surface JWT authenticates then fails 403. This does not assert owner OAuth/MCP parity. include accepts orders,subscription,bookings,registrations,invite_links, comma-separated at one level; omitted includes are absent. invite_links mints the user’s invite code for the home page on the first ask and returns the same code after. bookings (all of this user’s, newest first) and registrations (100 at a time, newest first) are the Booking and EventRegistration views; pass registrations_next_cursor back as registrations_cursor for the next 100, under the same pull:users scope. No ETag conditional response or Idempotency-Key requirement.

post.summary: Queue a push notification to one user
post.description: Delivers a transactional text with optional buttons to the user's private chat on the messenger they use (Telegram, MAX or VK), with a copy in the user's Open Lines topic; promotional messages go through broadcasts. Media is not delivered and is refused with INVALID_MEDIA. Callback buttons are an integration mechanism of an ExternalApp key: a tap is delivered by the button.clicked webhook to the server of the app that sent the push, and to no other app, so the app must have been subscribed to the button.clicked webhook when it was provisioned. A callback button for a MAX or VK user, from an ExternalApp without that webhook subscription or with its webhook deliveries auto-disabled, or sent with any credential other than an ExternalApp key (an OAuth grant or M2M credential), is refused with INVALID_BUTTON_CONFIG, and the Open Lines copy carries only the url buttons. 202 means queued: a push is dropped if not handed over for delivery within 24 hours, an accepted push not yet handed over is also dropped if the platform switches push delivery off in an emergency, and a user who blocked the bot or was deleted receives nothing. 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE means push notifications are switched off for now and nothing was queued.
